sentences.en: I minimized the document and then maximized it again.
sentences.zh: 我先缩小了文档，然后再将其最大化。

sentences.en: He should be promoted as soon as possible to maximize his chances.
sentences.zh: 他应尽快晋升以充分利用他的机会。

sentences.en: Yanni wants to maximize his chances of healing.
sentences.zh: 亚尼希望最大限度地提高康复的机会。

senses.zh: 把…增加到最大限度；尽量增大（等于maximize）
